name: Power-on, nominal battery 3.7 V, typical diode
limit: overshoot <= 10 % (REQ-OUT-05), steady current within 5 % of 4.0 A

name: Power-on at 3.15 V (just above the 3.08 V hardware UVLO), maximum-Vf diode
limit: overshoot <= 10 %, current within 5 %, peak inductor current < ILIM min 10.2 A

name: Current regulation across battery 3.0-4.2 V and diode Vf corners (incl. Vf below Vbat)
limit: model-level regulation within 2 % at every corner (tolerances excluded)

name: Input voltage reduction (4.0 -> 3.2 V over 1 ms, 40 mOhm source)
Load variation: diode Vf drops 0.15 V over 2 ms (faster than diode thermal time constants)
Flash transitions at full battery 4.2 V with lowest-Vf diode (Vf < Vbat region)
limit: peak <= 4.4 A on every turn-on; current < 50 mA within 2 ms of disable

name: Fault shutdown: interlock opens during emission
Output short-circuit (10 mOhm) during emission
limit: inductor current < 25 A cycle-by-cycle peak limit; output current settles <= 5.2 A (backup ceiling)

name: Open load (diode disconnected) during emission, hardware backstop only
limit: VOUT peak < 10 V (16 V-rated capacitors, 2x margin)

name: Reverse battery (-4.2 V): P-FET blocks (body diode reverse-biased, Vgs = 0)
Control-loop response (linearised model, 12 corners)
limit: PM >= 50 deg, GM >= 10 dB (time-domain step tests SIM-04/05 corroborate)
